idea-plugin.name: Repotory
idea-plugin.description:
The local-first memory layer for AI coding agents.
Search your Repotory knowledge base from inside the IDE and read the result in full, without leaving the editor.
Repotory keeps what your coding agents learn — why a decision was made, what gotcha you hit, what to do next — in a local, searchable store. This plugin is the reader for it:
• A T-shaped knowledge reader: brand header on top, your results as thumbnails on the left (kind, title, matched excerpt), and the selected knowledge expanded on the right — the first result is selected by default, and notes open in full with their markdown rendered. Todos show their excerpt, labelled as such. • Full-text search (FTS5) over every note and todo you ever captured, ranked exactly as the Repotory desktop app ranks it — the plugin reimplements no ranking, no snippet extraction, no gating. • One-click jump: double-click (or "Open in Repotory") deep-links the item into the Repotory web app. • Note maintenance in place: edit a note's title, kind, tags and 项目 (project), add a new note under the same 项目, or let the AI tidy a note into a restructured proposal — sections, an index, and a mermaid flowchart when the content is really a process. The proposal opens in the editor for your review; nothing is saved until you save it. • Works out of the box: if no service is running, the tool window offers "Start local service" and launches a repotory-server you already have (nothing is downloaded or built).
The plugin is a thin client: it talks to the loopback-only Repotory service over its local HTTP API. Everything stays on your machine — there is nothing to authenticate and nothing that leaves it. One build covers the whole IntelliJ family (IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand and the rest), on IntelliJ 2024.2 or newer, independently of your project's JDK.
